body_markdown:
Some of the most exciting artists in K-Music still have their biggest moments ahead. With Spotify CLOSER, we’re spotlighting Korean artists who are making a splash, bringing fans everywhere closer to their artistry and stories through a series of exclusive performances and conversations on Spotify.


The new series gives fans a K-Music showcase they can access right from Spotify. Each CLOSER artist takes the stage for an intimate, live performance before sitting down to share more about their music, creative world, and stories beyond the stage.


## **Hearts2Hearts makes a splash**


Our first featured artist is


[Hearts2Hearts](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1ZLU77nRzQIaP23mVSYpCQ) , a fast-growing group with a bright, confident pop sound and undeniable chemistry. Since debuting in February 2025, their monthly Spotify streams have grown nearly 20 times, earning more than 530 million streams this year alone. At the center for the rise is the viral hit “


[RUDE](https://open.spotify.com/track/2bAQsNqdo62T8akkIvWzGl?si=29acf1dc74154347) !,” now the group’s biggest track with more than 180 million streams.


Now, Hearts2Hearts is giving fans a new way to experience their music and charm through CLOSER. Filmed at their Spotify CLOSER show in Seoul, the new videos include the first-ever live performances of “


[ICONIC HEART (Korea Version)](https://open.spotify.com/track/2BLHTFy1rAtYwmm0uEFAuj?si=5266316902644ff2) ” and “


[Baby Steps](https://open.spotify.com/track/33hvf4epqKeIHEuy87Q6wr?si=4bbe02c3b7274c91) ,” along with a special acoustic version of “


[Butterflies](https://open.spotify.com/track/3s3Eo4rb6aq3O62g6z6jtZ?si=297205af144b4c33) .” Fans can also get closer to the members in the accompanying talk session, recorded during the event.


## **ALLDAY PROJECT takes it to the next level**


Next up is


[ALLDAY PROJECT](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4gEMn0YPOdotLOygnk0Ng2?si=RNo3eotlTAaB8eLUKPSrXw) , the co-ed group that has been making waves since their June 2025 debut. Their new breakout single, “


[FAMOUS](https://open.spotify.com/track/40UVUuyy5RfpO0awclCttA?si=929918a4b7be4516) ,” landed on the Billboard Global 200, making them the first mixed-gender K-Pop group to appear on the chart. On Spotify, they’ve seen growth in their monthly listeners, and their follower count has climbed at an even faster rate. Their songs can also be found in more than four million listener-made playlists.


Filmed at the group’s CLOSER show in Seoul, the new videos feature ALLDAY PROJECT’s first-ever live performances of “


[DO IT LIKE THIS](https://open.spotify.com/track/52Ec4vGiWOODvjFww1NVER?si=7f71b5f58d7c4147) ” and “


[UP ALL NIGHT](https://open.spotify.com/track/6Ej8v2iDKItTzsChmDRxhG?si=7885eeba678644bc) ,” plus a performance of “


[TALK](https://open.spotify.com/track/7JcBMmZu2brnM7M9PZmwYL?si=8121ab77a8044eb3) .” In the accompanying talk session, ANNIE, TARZZAN, BAILEY, WOOCHAN, and YOUNGSEO share stories from the practice room, and more about the music behind the group.


*Tune in to the Spotify*[CLOSER playlist](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4ZMcri6FXXc?si=18f0f9c74d114d6b&nd=1&dlsi=3eaef5ae22ff46d9) *—videos featuring*[LNGSHOT](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2F4oTJOWkcD1JaTeKEa9h6) *and more are coming soon.*
